CHEMISTRY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHEMISTRY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad.

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanoic acids ● Introduction to alkanoic acids, ● Nomenclature ● Preparation of.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols ● Introduction to alkanols ● Classification of alkanols ● Nomenclature .

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes 2.2. Electrochemistry 2.3 Nucl.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Energy Changes in physical and chemical processes ● System and surrounding ● Ene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry 2.3 Nuclear chemistry 3.0 Organic Chemistry 3.1 Alkanols 3.2 Al and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electrochemistry ● Redox reactions ● Electrochemical cell ● Standard electrode p and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Nuclear Chemistry ● Stability of isotopes ● Chemical and nuclear reactions ● Rad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
